name: skillforge
description: Skill packs and plugins for Claude Code, published by Entelligentsia

plugins.name: security-watchdog
plugins.description: Auto-scans newly installed Claude Code plugins for prompt injection, malicious hook scripts, and data exfiltration

plugins.name: freshdesk-api
plugins.description: Freshdesk helpdesk API skill — tickets, contacts, companies, knowledge base (Solutions), webhooks, and automation

plugins.name: walkinto
plugins.description: WalkInto.in virtual-tour platform and helpdesk — profile, 360 tours, knowledge base, and the support ticket lifecycle; bundles the WalkInto MCP server (13 tools) via a stdio bridge that reuses the plugin login token

plugins.name: doc-review
plugins.description: In-browser annotation overlay for HTML/Markdown/text documents; click Apply in the browser to have Claude Code apply edits to source within ~60s

plugins.name: design-patterns
plugins.description: 10 skills covering all 23 GoF patterns plus enterprise and DDD patterns

plugins.name: llm-patterns
plugins.description: 9 skills for LLM integration patterns — RAG, tool use, agents, guardrails, tool synthesis

plugins.name: harness-engineering
plugins.description: 13 skills for agent harness components — memory/compaction, session persistence, prompt caching, subagent orchestration, sandboxing, permissions, streaming, concurrency, telemetry, hooks, workspace state, model routing, rate limiting

plugins.name: meta-webxr-skills
plugins.description: 8 skills for Meta Quest PWA XR engineering

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Commit-time clean-code review gate — blocks unreviewed commits, reviews the staged diff against a layered rubric, and resolves findings through a single apply/manual/approve decision; silent when there is nothing to report

plugins.name: dev-tooling-audit
plugins.description: Audit a project for developer tooling gaps (LSP, AST, test runners, type checkers, linters, debuggers, dep graph) and recommend exact install steps to make Claude Code most effective

plugins.name: lean-ctx-eval
plugins.description: Evaluate whether the lean-ctx MCP saves more context tokens than it costs, using your Claude Code session transcripts — per-call counterfactual for ctx_read, observational baseline for ctx_shell, net token ledger after overhead

plugins.name: claude-usage
plugins.description: Report Claude Code token usage and equivalent Anthropic API cost by model for any date range from local session transcripts — dedup-accurate, cache priced at real per-entry TTL; the only place subscription usage is visible

plugins.name: forge-usage
plugins.description: Report forge-cli orchestrator run token usage and cost by model / project / sprint / phase for any date range, read from the central transcript archive (~/.pi/forge-cli/transcripts/) — the only place forge run usage is visible; uses the authoritative per-phase cost forge recorded at run time
